name: Diffuse Astrocytoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System (2021)

criteria.description: Histological evidence of diffuse infiltration by neoplastic astrocytes with low mitotic activity
MRI showing poorly circumscribed, infiltrative lesion without contrast enhancement
Presence of IDH1 or IDH2 mutation and absence of 1p/19q codeletion
Neurological symptoms consistent with tumor location

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of diffuse astrocytic infiltration with IDH mutation and compatible MRI findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of histology, molecular markers, and imaging per WHO CNS tumor classification.

searchTerms: head pain due to increased fluid in brain
loss of part of the vision field
blind spots or missing areas in vision

rare.symptomName: Endocrine dysfunction due to hypothalamic involvement
searchTerms: hormone problems from brain area damage
endocrine issues due to hypothalamus involvement
hormonal imbalance caused by brain tumor
cranial nerve palsies causing facial or eye problems

laboratory: CSF analysis typically non-specific; may show mild protein elevation
Molecular testing for IDH1/IDH2 mutations and 1p/19q codeletion
imaging: MRI: T2 hyperintense, non-enhancing, infiltrative lesion with poorly defined margins
Absence of contrast enhancement differentiates from higher grade gliomas
other: Histopathology showing diffuse astrocytic infiltration with low mitotic index

distinguishingFeatures: Higher mitotic activity and contrast enhancement on MRI
Marked contrast enhancement and necrosis on MRI

redFlags: New onset of seizures in adult
Signs of increased intracranial pressure such as papilledema
references: Louis DN et al. WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th Edition, 2021
Ostrom QT et al. CBTRUS Statistical Report: Primary Brain and Other Central Nervous System Tumors Diagnosed in the United States, 2014-2018
Weller M et al. EANO guidelines on the diagnosis and treatment of diffuse gliomas of adulthood, 2021
